description: The U.S. Energy Information Administration provides state-level electricity spreadsheets assembled from its EIA-860, EIA-923, EIA-861, EIA-861M and historical EIA-412 surveys. Topics include generating capacity, generation, fuel consumption, estimated emissions, customer sales and public-utility finances. The landing page identifies final 2025 annual data released on 7 October 2026 and monthly files through July 2026. Coverage differs by topic: some annual series begin in 1990, sales extend to 1960, and historical utility finances cover 2001–2003. Planned-capacity files cover 2026–2030 and must remain distinct from observed assets. The provider documents changes in sector classification and combined-heat-and-power fuel allocation that affect comparisons across years. These aggregates can support state-level electricity supply, demand and capacity scenarios. They overlap the underlying survey resources and are recorded as a derived state-level compilation, not independent measurements. Access is free through the public download directory. EIA states that its government publications are public domain and requests acknowledgement. Caveats: only landing-page metadata was inspected; no spreadsheets or archives were downloaded, and field completeness and units remain unverified. Related resources are the EIA survey catalogues.
